audit.whatIsWrong: Five strings call Ntofo Strikes a knockup ('his Q knockup', 'R to cleanse his Q knockups'). Riot's Q text is a line strike that slows, and at 2 stacks 'fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in' — a pull, not a knockup. The knockback and stun belong to Path Maker (W), and the through-wall launch belongs to All Out (R), yet dontsFull[0].t says 'Get walled by his Q'. Ragnarok is also described four times as 'cleansing' — Riot's text is 'immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking', a held immunity, not a removal. No K'Sante cooldown appears anywhere.
audit.why: Mixing up which button does what changes what the player dodges. You sidestep a line Q; you cannot sidestep a charged Path Maker the same way, and you back off the wall entirely against All Out. The Ragnarok framing matters because the immunity ends the moment Olaf stops attacking — so a K'Sante who dashes out with Footwork or Path Maker burns the 100/90/80s ult without ever being hit. And Ntofo Strikes is a 3.5-second cooldown: telling the player to 'trade around his cooldown' is meaningless unless the page says which cooldown, because that one never goes away.
audit.corrected: Path Maker named as the stun and All Out as the wall-launch in whys[4], spikes[2].text, wants.you[2], phases[4].why and content.mid. Ragnarok rewritten as immunity-while-attacking. All Out's 120s rank-1 cooldown and Ntofo Strikes' 3.5s written into dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tracks All Out but never gives its number, and never warns that Ntofo Strikes is uncooldownable at 3.5s.
audit.why: All Out at 120s rank 1 is a two-minute window in which K'Sante has no duel form — that is the whole plan and it deserved a number.
Executioner's Calling is justified here — All Out's text explicitly grants healing, unlike on the kled page where the same line was pasted against a champion with no heal.
